Workspace and committed values are visually distinct; claims are limited to atomicity.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 主体不变的推拉镜头
title_en: A dolly zoom with a stable subject
prompt_zh: 用Three.js制作16秒摄影机研究，1920×1080、60fps。主体为原创直立方框，放在白灰条纹室内，配色是白、灰、青绿；不使用人物或第三方素材。0–4秒固定视角；4–11秒摄影机后退，同时按投影公式减小视场角，方框在屏幕上高度保持不变；11–13秒显示两个参考边界；13–16秒反向恢复。背景应产生可观察的透视变化，画面标注摄影机实验，不宣称视觉心理效果。所有焦距、距离和运动由render(t)直接计算，关闭自动对焦与随机抖动。声音为一条低声上升音再返回。检查主体像素高度误差、摄影机不穿墙、首尾投影相同，交付关键帧、公式、源码与MP4。
prompt_en: Create a 16-second camera study in Three.js at 1920x1080, 60fps. Place an original upright rectangular frame in a white-gray striped room, using white, gray and teal, with no people or external assets. During 0–4s hold the initial view; 4–11s move the camera backward while narrowing its field of view according to the projection equation, keeping the subject's screen height constant; 11–13s show two reference bounds; 13–16s reverse to the starting state. Background perspective should visibly change. Label it a camera experiment without claims about psychological effects. Compute focal parameters, distance and motion directly from render(t), disabling autofocus and random shake. Use one quiet rising tone that returns to its starting pitch. Check subject pixel-height error, wall clearance and matching initial/final projections. Deliver keyframes, the projection formula, source and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: A quiet continuous sine glide rises during camera retreat and returns during the reverse movement.
checks_zh: 推拉期间主体屏幕高度相对初始值误差小于1%
首尾摄影机投影相同且路径不穿过房间墙体
全部标签位于画面5%安全边界内且环绕镜头时主体不出画
checks_en: Subject screen height stays within one percent of its initial height
Initial and final projection match and the camera route never crosses a wall
All labels remain within a five-percent frame-safe margin and the subject stays in frame during camera movement
recipe.audio_zh: 摄影机后退时一条低声正弦滑音上升，反向移动时回到起始音高。
recipe.audio_en: A quiet continuous sine glide rises during camera retreat and returns during the reverse movement.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 欧几里得节奏：把拍点均匀放开
title_en: Distribute pulses with a Euclidean rhythm
prompt_zh: 构建可玩的欧几里得节奏转盘和 16 秒固定操作 MP4，1080p 60fps，白底配酒红拍点与青色游标。使用 Bjorklund 算法生成 E(5,8)，固定起始旋转，Tone.js 或 Web Audio 精确调度，不能用视觉帧率计拍。玩家调步数 3–16、拍点数、旋转、速度、播放与静音；合法范围自动夹取且不改节奏规则。0–4 秒 E(3,8)；4–8 秒改为 E(5,8)；8–12 秒旋转两步；12–16 秒完成一圈并显示固定模式字符串。录制固定 120BPM 事件表，render(t) 同步光标与音频；暂停恢复不双响。每拍使用原创短合成木音，避免采样许可。验收拍点计数准确、旋转只改位置、音画偏差小于一帧。交付关键帧、代码、可玩页、MP4、节奏表。
prompt_en: Build a playable Euclidean-rhythm dial and a 16-second fixed-action MP4 at 1080p and 60fps. Use white, burgundy pulses and a cyan playhead. Generate E(5,8) with Bjorklund's algorithm and a fixed rotation convention. Schedule sound precisely with Tone.js or Web Audio, independent of visual frame rate. Support 3–16 steps, pulse count, rotation, tempo, play and mute; clamp valid ranges without changing the rule. During 0–4s show E(3,8); 4–8s change to E(5,8); 8–12s rotate two steps; 12–16s complete a cycle and show the exact pattern string. Use a fixed 120BPM event table for the recording, with render(t) aligning cursor and sound. Pause/resume must not double-trigger. Synthesize original short wood-like hits. Verify pulse counts, rotation-only positional change and audiovisual error below one frame. Deliver keyframes, source, playable page, MP4 and rhythm data.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Original 80ms wood-like synthesized hits run at 120BPM with bounded gain; silent steps remain completely silent.
recipe.audio_zh: 原创 80 毫秒木质感合成音按 120BPM 调度并限幅，空拍保持完全静默。
recipe.audio_en: Original 80ms wood-like synthesized hits run at 120BPM with bounded gain; silent steps remain completely silent.
checks_zh: E(k,n) 恰有 k 个拍点，旋转不改变间隔的环形集合。
音画同步误差小于 1/60 秒，暂停恢复不重复或漏拍。
checks_en: E(k,n) has exactly k pulses and rotation preserves circular interval structure.
Audiovisual error stays below 1/60 second; pause/resume neither duplicates nor drops hits.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 轮廓线接力完成三个动作
title_en: One contour hands off three actions
prompt_zh: 制作15秒工具动作片，1080p、60fps，使用项目自画几何轮廓而非第三方logo。配色为白、黑与钴蓝。0–4秒单线勾出收纳盒，表达收集；4–9秒盒子的上边连续延长成分组括号，表达整理；9–12秒括号末端转为向下箭头，表达导出；12–15秒三个状态并列定格。每个动作都有短双语标签，不用图标猜谜，轮廓拓扑变化处先显示连接点。render(t)驱动路径截取和形变，笔画宽度全程一致，避免线条突然跳位。合成三次短笔触音与完成时刻同步。检查轮廓无断裂、标签不被线覆盖及三个动作次序，交付关键帧、源码、中英版本和MP4。
prompt_en: Produce a 15-second tool-action film at 1080p, 60fps, using original geometric contours instead of third-party logos. Use white, black and cobalt. During 0–4s one line draws a container to represent collecting; 4–9s its top edge extends continuously into grouping brackets; 9–12s a bracket endpoint becomes a downward export arrow; 12–15s hold all three states side by side. Give every action a short bilingual label, and reveal connection points before topology changes so the transformation stays legible. Drive path trimming and morphing with render(t). Maintain one stroke width throughout and avoid instantaneous line jumps. Synthesize three brief drawing cues aligned to completed actions. Check contour continuity, labels unobscured by strokes and the collect-organize-export sequence. Deliver keyframes, editable source, Chinese and English text variants, and an MP4 with an optional silent version.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Three synthetic pencil-like cues finish with the collect, organize and export contours.
checks_zh: 连续接力轮廓在连接时刻没有断裂或瞬移
收集、整理、导出标签均不被笔画遮挡
checks_en: Contour handoffs contain no breaks or instantaneous jumps
Collect, organize and export labels remain clear of all strokes
recipe.audio_zh: 三次合成铅笔短音分别在收集、整理与导出轮廓完成时结束。
recipe.audio_en: Three synthetic pencil-like cues finish with the collect, organize and export contours.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 贝叶斯：阳性不等于高概率
title_en: Bayes: a positive result need not imply high probability
prompt_zh: 做 20 秒 1080p 30fps 双语频数图，用白底、紫红真阳性与蓝色假阳性解释基率。全部为虚构检测例：1000 人中 10 有目标状态；灵敏度 90%，990 个无状态者假阳性率 10%，得到 9 真阳性与 99 假阳性。0–5 秒建立 1000 点网格；5–10 秒显示两组检测结果；10–15 秒把 108 个阳性移成一条带；15–20 秒算 9/108≈8.33%。用 Canvas 固定点布局，render(t) 不能随机删点或混淆假阳性率与阳性预测值。数字与颜色都有标签，音频只提示分组和结论，不制造诊断权威。验收人数守恒、分母正确，注明不用于真实医疗判断。交付关键帧、源代码、计算表、MP4。
prompt_en: Create a 20-second bilingual frequency visualization at 1080p and 30fps on white, with magenta true positives and blue false positives. All inputs are fictional: of 1,000 people, ten have the target condition; sensitivity is 90%, and the 990 without it have a 10% false-positive rate. This gives nine true positives and 99 false positives. During 0–5s build the thousand-dot grid; 5–10s reveal both result groups; 10–15s gather the 108 positives into one band; 15–20s show 9/108, approximately 8.33%. Use a fixed Canvas layout and render(t); never randomly remove dots or confuse false-positive rate with positive predictive value. Pair every color with a label. Audio only marks grouping and calculation. Verify conserved counts and the denominator, and state that the example is not real medical guidance. Deliver keyframes, source, calculation data and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Two neutral grouping chimes and a short low-volume calculation tone; no alarm or clinical monitor sounds.
recipe.audio_zh: 使用两个中性分组铃音与轻微计算提示，不使用警报或医疗监护声音。
recipe.audio_en: Two neutral grouping chimes and a short low-volume calculation tone; no alarm or clinical monitor sounds.
checks_zh: 1000 人分组为 9 真阳性、1 假阴性、99 假阳性、891 真阴性。
最终概率为 9/108，演示假设与非真实医疗说明可读。
checks_en: Counts are 9 true positives, 1 false negative, 99 false positives and 891 true negatives.
The final probability is 9/108, with readable fictional-input and nonclinical labels.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 同一结构的两种投影
title_en: Two projections of the same structure
prompt_zh: 用Three.js制作20秒投影比较，1080p、60fps。主体为六个阶梯状矩形模块，浅灰地面、深绿主体、玫红参考线。0–5秒正交视图展示平行边；5–11秒用匹配主体中心与高度的连续参数过渡到透视；11–16秒标出远近边大小差；16–20秒恢复正交视图。结构不移动，只有投影变化，文本说明这不是物体形变；不制作可误认真实建筑的场景。使用经过验证的摄影机投影插值或两镜头可控混合，render(t)确保跳时一致，固定阴影。音频用单次轻扫和两个短提示。检查正交平行线、透视灭点、主体中心稳定和过渡不闪白，交付双语关键帧、源码、投影参数与MP4。
prompt_en: Make a 20-second projection comparison in Three.js at 1080p, 60fps. Use six stepped rectangular modules on a light-gray floor, with deep-green geometry and rose reference lines. At 0–5s show parallel edges in an orthographic view; 5–11s transition continuously to perspective while matching subject center and height; 11–16s mark the apparent size difference between near and far edges; 16–20s return to orthographic. Keep the structure stationary and explain that projection changes rather than geometry deformation. Avoid a scene that could be mistaken for an actual building. Use validated camera-projection interpolation or a controlled two-camera blend, with render(t) giving identical results after seeking and fixed shadows. Compose one soft sweep and two short cues. Verify orthographic parallel lines, the perspective vanishing point, stable subject center and no flash during the transition. Deliver bilingual keyframes, source, projection parameters and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: One subtle sweep follows the projection change; two short notes mark the comparison bounds.
checks_zh: 正交视图中平行边保持平行、透视视图参考线汇聚正确
过渡时主体中心偏移不超过画面宽度1%
全部标签位于画面5%安全边界内且环绕镜头时主体不出画
checks_en: Parallel edges stay parallel in orthographic mode and converge correctly in perspective
Subject-center drift stays below one percent of frame width during the transition
All labels remain within a five-percent frame-safe margin and the subject stays in frame during camera movement
recipe.audio_zh: 一次轻扫音跟随投影变化；两声短音标记比较边界。
recipe.audio_en: One subtle sweep follows the projection change; two short notes mark the comparison bounds.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 流程路由器：把条件接到结果
title_en: Route a condition into a result
prompt_zh: 构建可操作流程图路由器与 18 秒固定操作 MP4，1080p 60fps，白底配青绿通过与莓红拒绝。使用 ELK.js 分层布局与 SVG 边，规则采用可核验有限有向无环图：输入金额→金额≥100?→优惠/原价，所有金额是演示单位。玩家可连接节点、改阈值、输入值、运行、撤销与重置；禁止形成循环并说明被拒原因，连线支持键盘操作。0–4 秒加载流程；4–8 秒输入 80 走原价；8–12 秒改为 120 走优惠；12–15 秒阈值改为 150 重新走原价；15–18 秒撤销恢复。录制固定动作预计算布局与执行轨迹，render(t) 不每帧重新排版。音频仅在分支决定时双选一。验收阈值边界、无悬空执行、连线不盖标签。交付关键帧、源码、可玩页、MP4、图 JSON。
prompt_en: Build a playable flow router and an 18-second fixed-action MP4 at 1080p and 60fps. Use white, teal acceptance and berry rejection. Use ELK.js layered layout with SVG edges and a verifiable finite DAG: input amount, test amount>=100, then discount or regular price. Amounts are synthetic units. Support connecting nodes, editing threshold, value input, run, undo and reset. Reject cycles with clear feedback and support keyboard connections. During 0–4s load the graph; 4–8s run 80 through regular price; 8–12s run 120 through discount; 12–15s raise the threshold to 150 and run regular price; 15–18s undo. Precompute fixed-action layout and execution for render(t); never relayout every frame. Use one of two quiet branch tones. Verify equality at threshold, no dangling execution and unobscured edge labels. Deliver keyframes, source, playable page, MP4 and graph JSON.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: A low branch note marks regular price and a higher note marks discount; undo uses a soft reverse cue with no continuous hum.
recipe.audio_zh: 原价分支使用低音，优惠分支使用较高音，撤销使用轻反向提示，无持续嗡声。
recipe.audio_en: A low branch note marks regular price and a higher note marks discount; undo uses a soft reverse cue with no continuous hum.
checks_zh: 金额等于阈值时进入优惠分支；固定录制的三次结果准确。
循环连线被拒绝，撤销恢复阈值、布局与图结构。
checks_en: Equality takes the discount branch; all three scripted results are correct.
Cycles are rejected and undo restores threshold, layout and graph structure.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 热力格变成可比较的排序
title_en: A heatmap becomes a comparable ranking
prompt_zh: 制作20秒数据阅读片，1920×1080、60fps，Canvas绘制4×4演示矩阵。采用白底、青绿单色量级与品红选中标记。0–5秒填入固定整数矩阵和0到9图例；5–10秒选中四行并计算各行总和；10–15秒整行格子收拢成等尺度水平条；15–20秒按总和降序排列，原行编号保持可见。矩阵必须标注虚构示例，不解释为真实人口或风险；相同值保持相同颜色。render(t)与固定排序规则计算位置，相同总和按原编号稳定排序。音频随四行汇总作短音，不把排名做成胜负庆典。检查总和、稳定排序与颜色图例，交付中英关键帧、输入矩阵、源码和MP4。
prompt_en: Create a 20-second data-reading film at 1920x1080, 60fps, with a fixed 4x4 integer matrix drawn in Canvas. Use white, a teal value scale and magenta selection marks. At 0–5s populate the matrix and a 0-to-9 legend; 5–10s select the four rows and calculate their totals; 10–15s gather each row into a horizontal bar on a shared scale; 15–20s sort bars by descending total while retaining original row identifiers. Label the matrix as fictional and avoid claims about population, risk or real activity. Equal values must have equal colors. Compute locations using render(t) and a fixed sort rule, retaining original order for tied totals. Use short quiet notes for aggregation rather than celebratory ranking sounds. Check arithmetic, stable sorting and legend mapping. Deliver bilingual keyframes, the input matrix, source and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Four muted marimba-like notes mark row aggregation; a subdued sweep accompanies the stable sort.
checks_zh: 各行条形长度严格对应矩阵行总和
相同总和保留原始行编号顺序且图例映射一致
checks_en: Every bar length matches its matrix row sum
Tied totals preserve original row order and value colors match the legend
recipe.audio_zh: 四声柔和马林巴音标记行汇总；低声滑音跟随稳定排序。
recipe.audio_en: Four muted marimba-like notes mark row aggregation; a subdued sweep accompanies the stable sort.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 准确率之外：精确率与召回率
title_en: Beyond accuracy: precision and recall
prompt_zh: 用 18 秒 1080p 60fps 双语动画建立二分类混淆矩阵，浅灰底、青绿正确与红色错误，同时用文字标签。固定演示计数 TP=30、FP=10、FN=20、TN=40，总数 100，不宣称真实模型成绩。0–5 秒把四组样本放进带轴标签的矩阵；5–9 秒圈预测阳性列，计算 precision=30/40=75%；9–13 秒圈真实阳性行，计算 recall=30/50=60%；13–18 秒并排保留 accuracy=70%、precision=75%、recall=60%。用 SVG 与纯计数模型 render(t)，不能在同一分母中重复计数。声音通过两段不同但等响的短音区分指标。验收轴方向、计数、百分比和手机布局。交付关键帧、源码、计数表、MP4。
prompt_en: Build a bilingual binary-classification confusion matrix in 18 seconds at 1080p and 60fps. Use pale gray, teal for correct outcomes and red for errors, always with text labels. Fixed demonstration counts are TP=30, FP=10, FN=20 and TN=40, totaling 100; do not present them as measured model performance. During 0–5s place all four groups into a clearly labelled matrix; 5–9s highlight the predicted-positive column and calculate precision=30/40=75%; 9–13s highlight the actual-positive row and calculate recall=30/50=60%; 13–18s hold accuracy=70%, precision=75% and recall=60% together. Render SVG from a pure count model through render(t), never double-counting a denominator. Use two distinct equally quiet motifs to distinguish metrics. Verify axis orientation, counts, percentages and mobile layout. Deliver keyframes, source, count data and MP4 with reproducible calculations.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Precision uses two ascending soft notes; recall uses two descending notes at equal loudness; the final metrics are held in silence.
recipe.audio_zh: 精确率使用两声上行轻音，召回率使用等响两声下行轻音，最终指标静默停留。
recipe.audio_en: Precision uses two ascending soft notes; recall uses two descending notes at equal loudness; the final metrics are held in silence.
checks_zh: 计数合计 100，准确率 70%、精确率 75%、召回率 60%。
真实标签与预测标签的轴始终明确，指标分母高亮准确。
checks_en: Counts total 100; accuracy is 70%, precision 75% and recall 60%.
Actual and predicted axes stay explicit, and each metric highlights the correct denominator.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 水磨石切片里的颗粒
title_en: Aggregate inside a terrazzo section
prompt_zh: 用Three.js制作18秒复合材料观察，1920×1080、60fps。自建水磨石样块，雾白底，灰绿基体与少量红、白碎片；颗粒是结构内容，不能当漂浮装饰。0–4秒正面展示完整样块；4–10秒一块截面沿深度滑过，揭示固定种子的内部颗粒；10–14秒镜头靠近截面；14–18秒恢复中景显示“程序材质”。基体与颗粒交界连续，说明并非真实石材扫描，不宣称耐磨或承重。使用自有程序纹理与封口几何，render(t)计算切片与摄影机，固定曝光。音频为低声磨擦与一次轻点击。检查切片封口、表面与内部颗粒对应、无贴图伸缩，交付关键帧、源码、种子参数和MP4。
prompt_en: Use Three.js for an 18-second composite-material study at 1920x1080, 60fps. Build an original terrazzo block on mist white, with a gray-green matrix and sparse red and white aggregate. The particles belong to the material structure rather than floating decoration. During 0–4s present the intact sample; 4–10s move a section through its depth, exposing fixed-seed internal aggregate; 10–14s approach the section with the camera; 14–18s return to a medium view and show Procedural material. Keep matrix-aggregate boundaries continuous and explain that this is not a scan of actual stone. Make no abrasion or load-bearing claims. Use original procedural textures and capped geometry, computing section and camera transforms through render(t) with fixed exposure. Add quiet friction texture and one gentle click. Check section caps, surface-interior aggregate correspondence and texture stretching. Deliver keyframes, source, seed parameters and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Quiet synthesized friction follows section movement; one gentle click marks the close-up hold.
checks_zh: 切片封口上颗粒与体积中的固定种子位置一致
摄影机靠近时基体和颗粒纹理没有明显拉伸
全部标签位于画面5%安全边界内且环绕镜头时主体不出画
checks_en: Aggregate on section caps matches fixed-seed positions inside the volume
Matrix and aggregate textures show no obvious stretching in the close-up
All labels remain within a five-percent frame-safe margin and the subject stays in frame during camera movement
recipe.audio_zh: 低声合成摩擦纹理跟随剖切移动；近景停留时一次轻点击。
recipe.audio_en: Quiet synthesized friction follows section movement; one gentle click marks the close-up hold.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 正则实验台：看见每一次匹配
title_en: A regex workbench with visible matches
prompt_zh: 构建可操作正则实验台与 14 秒固定操作 MP4，1080p 60fps，白底配靛青匹配与珊瑚错误。文本固定为 order-12 order-7 draft-03，演示模式为 order-(\d+)，展示完整匹配、组 1 和字符区间。玩家可改表达式、旗标和文本，支持清空、重置、复制匹配结果；原生 JavaScript 正则放 Worker，设置执行预算并可终止，不允许恶意输入卡死主线程。0–4 秒文本；4–8 秒输入模式得到两次匹配；8–11 秒打开组视图；11–14 秒输入非法括号并可恢复错误。录制固定动作 render(t)，不要以真实浏览器计算时间宣称速度。音频匹配轻点击、语法错误中性提示。验收索引与 Unicode 显示对应、空匹配能前进、用户文本安全转义。交付关键帧、源码、可玩页、MP4、匹配 JSON。
prompt_en: Build a playable regex workbench and a 14-second fixed-action MP4 at 1080p and 60fps. Use white, indigo matches and coral errors. Fixed text is order-12 order-7 draft-03; the demonstration pattern is order-(\d+). Show full matches, capture group one and character ranges. Let users edit pattern, flags and text, clear, reset and copy results. Run native JavaScript regex in a Worker with an execution budget and termination so hostile patterns cannot freeze the main thread. During 0–4s show text; 4–8s enter the pattern and reveal two matches; 8–11s open capture view; 11–14s enter an invalid parenthesis and recover from the error. Reconstruct recording with fixed actions and render(t); do not claim benchmark speed. Use quiet match clicks and neutral error feedback. Verify indices, Unicode display, zero-length progression and safe text escaping. Deliver keyframes, source, playable page, MP4 and match JSON.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Each revealed match uses one quiet click; invalid syntax uses a neutral two-note cue and recovery uses no celebratory sound.
recipe.audio_zh: 每个揭示匹配使用轻点击，非法语法使用中性双音，恢复时不添加庆祝音。
recipe.audio_en: Each revealed match uses one quiet click; invalid syntax uses a neutral two-note cue and recovery uses no celebratory sound.
checks_zh: 结果恰为 order-12 与 order-7，捕获组为 12 与 7，字符区间正确。
非法表达式与超时可恢复，零长度匹配不会无限循环，输出按文本转义。
checks_en: Matches are exactly order-12 and order-7, captures are 12 and 7, and ranges are correct.
Invalid patterns and timeouts recover, zero-length matches cannot loop forever, and output is escaped text.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 两种语言共享一个节奏
title_en: Two languages share one rhythm
prompt_zh: 制作16秒双语动态标题研究，1080p、60fps，Canvas进行真实字形测量。使用原创中英同义短句，画面为白、墨黑和莓红。0–4秒中文标题居中展开；4–8秒两侧边界向外移动，为英文长度腾出空间；8–12秒中文逐行退到副标题位，英文以相同节拍出现；12–16秒两种语言形成主副标题并静止。语言切换不逐字机械对译，内容由输入确认；两版字号保持固定，只调整行数、版面宽度与位置。render(t)驱动剪裁与透明度，不用模糊遮掩文字。声音用四组轻击保持相同节奏。检查最长单词、中文标点、字幕边界和完整阅读时间，交付双语文本、关键帧、源码与MP4。
prompt_en: Make a 16-second bilingual title study at 1080p, 60fps, using real Canvas glyph measurement. Supply an original Chinese sentence and its approved English equivalent, with white, ink black and berry red. During 0–4s the Chinese title opens at center; 4–8s move the layout boundaries outward to accommodate English length; 8–12s move Chinese into the subtitle position while English enters on the same rhythm; 12–16s hold a complete bilingual title composition. Preserve meaning rather than mechanically substituting characters. Keep fixed font sizes and adapt line count, layout width and position. Drive clipping and opacity through render(t), avoiding blur that conceals text. Use four groups of soft taps sharing one rhythmic pattern. Inspect the longest English word, Chinese punctuation, caption boundaries and reading duration. Deliver approved bilingual text, keyframes, source and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Four repeated groups of soft taps maintain the same rhythm during both language reveals.
checks_zh: 最长英文单词完整容纳且中英字号不随视口缩放
中英文同义内容在最终静止画面都完整可读
checks_en: The longest English word fits without viewport-dependent font scaling
Both equivalent statements remain completely readable in the final hold
recipe.audio_zh: 四组重复轻击保持两种语言揭示时的相同节奏。
recipe.audio_en: Four repeated groups of soft taps maintain the same rhythm during both language reveals.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 因果注意力：当前词看不到未来
title_en: Causal attention cannot see future tokens
prompt_zh: 制作 20 秒 1080p 60fps 双语因果注意力动画，白底配蓝绿权重与洋红遮罩。用四个虚构 token 和固定分数 [1,2,0,3]，观察第三个 token 的查询，仅允许前 3 个位置；softmax 权重为 exp([1,2,0]) 的归一化，未来位置设为 0。0–4 秒建立 token；4–8 秒展示查询与分数；8–13 秒加因果遮罩并计算权重；13–17 秒加权合成示意向量；17–20 秒说明是单头简化模型，权重并非事实依据或完整解释。Canvas 按预计算数值 render(t)，不同位置权重总和为 1，遮罩不只降低透明度而保留非零值。声音三声轻音按权重变化。验收未来权重零、计算准确、标签手机可读。交付关键帧、代码、数值表、MP4。
prompt_en: Create a 20-second bilingual causal-attention schematic at 1080p and 60fps. Use white, blue-green weights and a magenta mask. Four fictional tokens have scores [1,2,0,3]. For the third token's query, only the first three positions are allowed: normalize exp([1,2,0]) and set the future position's weight to zero. During 0–4s place tokens; 4–8s show query and scores; 8–13s apply the causal mask and calculate weights; 13–17s combine illustrative value vectors; 17–20s state that this is a simplified single-head model and attention weights are not factual evidence or a complete explanation. Drive Canvas with precomputed numbers and render(t). Allowed weights sum to one; masking must actually zero the future weight. Three quiet notes reflect permitted weights. Check exact normalization, zero future contribution and mobile labels. Deliver keyframes, source, numerical data and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Three quiet sine notes use gains proportional to the allowed attention weights; the masked token is silent.
recipe.audio_zh: 三个轻正弦音的音量按允许位置注意力权重变化，被遮罩未来 token 保持静默。
recipe.audio_en: Three quiet sine notes use gains proportional to the allowed attention weights; the masked token is silent.
checks_zh: 单头示意声明可见，加权合成使用与标签相同的数值。
checks_en: Allowed weights are approximately [0.244728,0.665241,0.090031], with future weight zero.
The single-head disclaimer is visible and weighted values use the same numbers as their labels.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 环带交错但不相交
title_en: A woven ribbon crosses without intersecting
prompt_zh: 用Three.js制作23秒空间曲线实验，1080p、60fps，主体为一条自定义连续扁带，白底配青绿与紫红两面。0–6秒从侧面看到扁带展开；6–13秒沿固定曲线路径形成两次上下交错；13–19秒摄影机绕中心半圈，观察间隙；19–23秒保持结构并显示前后面标记。曲线与厚度由参数定义，不能说成真实结绳力学；禁止装饰球和随机扭曲。使用平行运输框架或稳定标架生成带面，render(t)确保法线不会突然翻转，柔和光照。声音为轻滑音和两次交错提示。检查自交、最小间隙、法线连续与两面色一致，交付参数、关键帧、源码和MP4。
prompt_en: Create a 23-second spatial-curve experiment in Three.js at 1080p, 60fps, using one original continuous flat ribbon on white with teal and magenta opposite faces. At 0–6s view the extended ribbon from the side; 6–13s form two over-under crossings along a fixed curve; 13–19s orbit the camera halfway around the center to inspect clearance; 19–23s hold the structure with front/back markers. Define curve and thickness parametrically and avoid claims about actual knot mechanics. Do not add decorative spheres or random twisting. Generate the strip with a parallel-transport frame or another stable framing method. Make render(t) prevent sudden normal flips under soft lighting. Compose a gentle glide and two small crossing cues. Check self-intersections, minimum clearance, continuous normals and consistent face colors. Deliver the curve parameters, keyframes, source and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: A quiet sliding tone follows ribbon formation; two brief cues mark the over-under crossings.
checks_zh: 环带两处交错都保留正的最小间隙
镜头环绕与形变时法线不翻转、正反面颜色不交换
全部标签位于画面5%安全边界内且环绕镜头时主体不出画
checks_en: Both over-under crossings retain positive minimum clearance
Normals never flip and front/back colors never exchange during deformation or orbit
All labels remain within a five-percent frame-safe margin and the subject stays in frame during camera movement
recipe.audio_zh: 一条轻滑音跟随带面成形；两声短提示标记上下交错。
recipe.audio_en: A quiet sliding tone follows ribbon formation; two brief cues mark the over-under crossings.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 文本差异台：看清修改在哪里
title_en: A text-diff bench shows what changed
prompt_zh: 构建可操作双栏文本 diff 台与 16 秒固定操作 MP4，1080p 60fps，白底配青绿新增、莓红删除，并用 +/- 标签。使用 diff 库按行生成块，输入为原创三行短文本，不放外部代码。玩家可编辑两侧、切换并排/统一、忽略行尾空格、撤销与重置；移动端统一视图避免超宽。0–4 秒两份相同文本；4–8 秒改一行；8–11 秒追加一行；11–14 秒切换统一视图；14–16 秒显示新增/删除数量。固定动作的 diff 结果预计算供 render(t)，颜色不单独表达含义，不能把修改行计算成两个新增。声音删除低点击、新增高点击，不逐字符响。验收计数与库结果一致、行号保持正确、空文本和长行能处理。交付关键帧、源码、可玩页、MP4、diff 数据。
prompt_en: Build a playable two-column text-diff bench and a 16-second fixed-action MP4 at 1080p and 60fps. Use white, teal additions and berry deletions, always with plus/minus labels. Use the diff library for line-level hunks and three lines of original sample text rather than external code. Support editing both versions, side-by-side/unified modes, trailing-space ignore, undo and reset. Use unified mode on mobile to avoid excessive width. During 0–4s show identical texts; 4–8s change one line; 8–11s append one; 11–14s switch to unified mode; 14–16s show added/deleted line counts. Precompute fixed-action diffs for render(t), without relying on color alone or miscounting a replaced line as two additions. Use one low removal click and high addition click per hunk. Verify library counts, line numbers, empty input and long-line wrapping. Deliver keyframes, source, playable page, MP4 and diff data.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: One soft low click marks a removed hunk and one higher click an added hunk; editing individual characters remains silent.
recipe.audio_zh: 删除块使用轻低点击，新增块使用较高点击，逐字符编辑保持静默。
recipe.audio_en: One soft low click marks a removed hunk and one higher click an added hunk; editing individual characters remains silent.
checks_zh: 一行替换加一行追加得到删除 1 行、新增 2 行，行号对应原文本。
空文本、无末尾换行与长行均可切换视图而不丢字符。
checks_en: One replaced line plus one appended line produces one deletion and two additions with correct line numbers.
Empty text, missing final newline and long lines retain every character across views.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 一条路径描出产品轮廓
title_en: One route traces a product outline
prompt_zh: 制作18秒原创桌面计时器发布片，1920×1080、60fps，用SVG绘制二维外形。白底配炭灰与草绿，无第三方设计或logo。0–4秒一条路线依次经过三个功能标签；4–10秒路线回收并连续变为计时器外壳轮廓；10–14秒内部出现显示区与旋钮；14–18秒显示自写名称和“概念产品”。路径形变保持点顺序，标签先移开再进入产品，避免线穿文字。不得宣称续航、防水或精度；尺寸只是演示比例。render(t)决定所有点坐标，声音沿三个标签作短点击，外壳完成时低音收束。检查路径闭合、产品轮廓可识别和最终读屏，交付双语关键帧、可编辑源码和MP4。
prompt_en: Create an 18-second launch film for an original desktop timer concept at 1920x1080, 60fps, drawing its 2D form with SVG. Use white, charcoal and grass green, without third-party product designs or logos. At 0–4s one route passes three feature labels; 4–10s gather the route into a continuous timer enclosure outline; 10–14s reveal its display and dial; 14–18s hold an original name and Concept product. Preserve path-point order throughout the morph. Move labels clear before the enclosure forms so strokes never cross text. Do not claim battery life, waterproofing or accuracy; dimensions are illustrative proportions only. Compute all coordinates through render(t). Add three brief clicks along the labels and a low closing tone when the outline completes. Verify path closure, a recognizable product silhouette and final reading time. Deliver bilingual keyframes, editable source and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Three small click cues accompany feature stops; one low synthesized tone marks the closed product outline.
checks_zh: 形变完成后外壳路径闭合且没有自交
最终产品名、概念标注和轮廓在手机上可辨认
checks_en: The final enclosure path is closed without self-intersections
The name, concept label and product outline remain recognizable on a phone
recipe.audio_zh: 三个短点击对应功能标签；外壳轮廓闭合时播放一次低音。
recipe.audio_en: Three small click cues accompany feature stops; one low synthesized tone marks the closed product outline.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 过拟合：训练变好，验证变差
title_en: Overfitting: training improves while validation worsens
prompt_zh: 做 18 秒 1080p 60fps 双语机器学习示意，白底配青色训练线、紫红验证线，全部曲线注明合成而非实验成绩。用八个 epoch 的固定损失：训练 [0.8,0.6,0.45,0.34,0.26,0.2,0.16,0.13]，验证 [0.85,0.65,0.5,0.43,0.46,0.51,0.58,0.66]。0–4 秒介绍训练/验证拆分；4–10 秒逐点描线；10–14 秒标出验证最优 epoch 4；14–18 秒解释停止点由验证策略决定，最终评估使用独立测试集。SVG 固定坐标 render(t)，不使用测试集选停止点，也不声称曲线一定证明原因。音频用稳定轻节拍，最优点单次铃音。检查坐标比例与所有值一致，关键帧读得出最小值。交付关键帧、源代码、CSV、MP4。
prompt_en: Create an 18-second bilingual machine-learning schematic at 1080p and 60fps. Use white, cyan training loss and magenta validation loss. Label all curves as synthetic, not experiment results. Across eight epochs, fix training loss at [0.8,0.6,0.45,0.34,0.26,0.2,0.16,0.13] and validation at [0.85,0.65,0.5,0.43,0.46,0.51,0.58,0.66]. During 0–4s introduce the training/validation split; 4–10s reveal points; 10–14s mark epoch 4 as the lowest validation loss; 14–18s explain that validation policy selects a stopping point while independent test data is reserved for final evaluation. Use fixed SVG axes with render(t). Never use the test set to select the stop or claim the curves establish causation. A quiet steady beat accompanies epochs and one bell marks the minimum. Verify scales and all values. Deliver keyframes, source, CSV and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Eight low-volume metronome taps accompany epochs; one higher bell marks validation minimum at epoch four.
recipe.audio_zh: 八次低音量节拍对应 epoch，第四个 epoch 的验证最低点使用单次较高铃音。
recipe.audio_en: Eight low-volume metronome taps accompany epochs; one higher bell marks validation minimum at epoch four.
checks_zh: 验证最小值为 epoch 4 的 0.43，所有点与固定数组一致。
训练、验证、独立测试用途区分清楚，曲线显式标为合成。
checks_en: Validation minimum is 0.43 at epoch four and every point matches the arrays.
Training, validation and independent test roles are distinct; curves are labelled synthetic.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 同一物体的三种灯色
title_en: One object under three light colors
prompt_zh: 用Three.js制作17秒灯光比较，1920×1080、60fps。主体是原创带倒角的白色方盒与灰卡，场景白灰，辅助标记深绿。0–4秒中性主光照明；4–9秒主光颜色逐步变暖，光源intensity与曝光参数固定；9–13秒变为偏冷，显示预设颜色标签；13–17秒回中性并停留。使用明确RGB灯色预设，不把标签说成经仪器测量的色温；固定曝光、白平衡和材质，保持明确且一致的比较条件，允许不同灯色产生不同视觉亮度。render(t)从同一时间线计算灯色，摄影机完全固定。声音用三个低音短音标记状态。检查灰卡像素值变化有记录、颜色标签正确、反射不过曝和手机辨色，交付参数、关键帧、源码、中英标签和MP4。
prompt_en: Use Three.js to create a 17-second lighting comparison at 1920x1080, 60fps. Show an original beveled white box and gray card in a white-gray scene, with deep-green annotation marks. During 0–4s use a neutral key light; 4–9s gradually warm its color while keeping intensity fixed; 9–13s move to a cool preset and show the preset label; 13–17s return to neutral and hold. Use explicit RGB light-color presets rather than implying instrument-measured color temperature. Fix exposure, white balance and materials to retain consistent comparison conditions while allowing different light colors to change perceived brightness. Calculate light color from one render(t) timeline and keep the camera stationary. Compose three low short notes for the states. Record gray-card pixel-value changes and check, correct preset labels, unclipped reflections and distinguishable colors on a phone. Deliver parameters, keyframes, source, bilingual labels and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Three low, quiet notes identify neutral, warm and cool light states, with no continuous music.
checks_zh: 三种灯色预设使用同一灯光强度、曝光与材质参数
灯色标签和实际RGB预设一致且反射无明显截白
全部标签位于画面5%安全边界内且环绕镜头时主体不出画
checks_en: All three presets share the same light intensity, exposure and material parameters
Preset labels match actual RGB settings and reflections avoid broad clipping
All labels remain within a five-percent frame-safe margin and the subject stays in frame during camera movement
recipe.audio_zh: 三声低而轻的短音标记中性、暖、冷灯色，不播放持续音乐。
recipe.audio_en: Three low, quiet notes identify neutral, warm and cool light states, with no continuous music.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 像素位图：每格就是一个比特
title_en: A pixel bitmap with one bit per cell
prompt_zh: 构建可玩的 8×8 二值像素编辑器与 14 秒固定操作 MP4，1080p 60fps，白底配墨黑像素与玫红行选择。支持画笔、擦除、清空、撤销、水平镜像、PNG 导出与 8 字节十六进制导出，固定行优先且最高位表示最左格。0–4 秒画原创阶梯图；4–7 秒选一行显示 10110000=0xB0；7–10 秒水平镜像；10–12 秒撤销；12–14 秒导出并回读。Canvas 像素使用整数对齐无平滑，DOM 十六进制文本始终跟随真实位图。录制固定操作 render(t)，触屏绘图按格采样而非随机线插值。声音画笔每条笔划一声轻点击，镜像短双音。验收导入导出完全往返、撤销不改历史起点、移动端网格稳定。交付关键帧、源代码、可玩页、MP4 与导出样本。
prompt_en: Build a playable 8x8 binary-pixel editor and a 14-second fixed-action MP4 at 1080p and 60fps. Use white, ink pixels and rose row selection. Provide brush, erase, clear, undo, horizontal mirror, PNG export and eight-byte hexadecimal export. Specify row-major order with the most significant bit as the leftmost cell. During 0–4s draw an original stair motif; 4–7s select a row showing 10110000=0xB0; 7–10s mirror horizontally; 10–12s undo; 12–14s export and read back. Draw integer-aligned Canvas cells without smoothing and derive DOM hex text from the real bitmap. Use fixed recording actions with render(t); touch painting samples actual cells rather than random interpolation. One quiet click marks each stroke and a double tone marks mirroring. Verify exact import/export round-trip, undo history and stable mobile grid dimensions. Deliver keyframes, source, playable page, MP4 and export samples.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Each completed brush stroke gets one quiet click; mirroring uses a symmetric two-note cue and exporting uses a short paper-like tap.
recipe.audio_zh: 每个完整笔划一声轻点击，镜像使用对称双音，导出使用短纸感敲击。
recipe.audio_en: Each completed brush stroke gets one quiet click; mirroring uses a symmetric two-note cue and exporting uses a short paper-like tap.
checks_zh: 10110000 编码为 0xB0，水平镜像后位顺序反转且二次镜像复原。
8 字节导出回读后 64 格完全一致，PNG 无抗锯齿或错位边缘。
checks_en: 10110000 encodes as 0xB0; mirroring reverses bits and two mirrors restore the bitmap.
Eight-byte export round-trips all 64 cells and PNG has no antialiasing or shifted edges.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 百分比保持面积守恒
title_en: Percentages preserve total area
prompt_zh: 制作19秒数据图形片，1920×1080、60fps，使用SVG矩形与路径。输入演示比例30%、45%、25%，配色为白、钴蓝、玫红和松绿。0–5秒三个百分比从同一单位方格上方出现；5–11秒方格按比例分割，三块沿直线分开但面积不变；11–15秒块体连续排成100%横条；15–19秒返回完整方格并保持数值。画面标注虚构比例，不把面积当真实市场份额或调查结果。所有矩形尺寸与文字从固定数据及render(t)计算，禁止靠任意缩放制造视觉夸大。用三个短音标记比例，一次轻滑音连接排条。检查面积之和恒为100%、块体身份不变、百分比标签安全区和手机可读性，交付中英版本、关键帧、源码与MP4。
prompt_en: Create a 19-second data-geometry film at 1920x1080, 60fps, using SVG rectangles and paths. Use demonstration shares of 30%, 45% and 25%, with white, cobalt, rose and pine green. At 0–5s reveal the percentages above one unit square; 5–11s divide the square proportionally and separate its three pieces along straight routes without changing their areas; 11–15s arrange them continuously into a 100% bar; 15–19s restore the complete square while retaining labels. Explicitly call these fictional shares, not market data or survey results. Derive all geometry and text from fixed data and render(t). Avoid arbitrary scaling that exaggerates a category. Use three short tones for the shares and one quiet glide for the bar formation. Check conserved total area, stable piece identity, caption-safe percentage labels and phone readability. Deliver Chinese and English versions, keyframes, editable source and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: Three short plucks identify the shares; one quiet glide follows the area-preserving transition into a bar.
recipe.audio_zh: 三个短拨音分别提示三种比例；一条轻滑音跟随保持面积的横条转场。
recipe.audio_en: Three short plucks identify the shares; one quiet glide follows the area-preserving transition into a bar.
checks_zh: 分块和横条的总面积始终等于单位方格面积
三个块体面积分别占30%、45%、25%且标签保持身份
checks_en: The pieces and bar always total the same area as the unit square
Piece areas remain 30%, 45% and 25% with stable label identity

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 游标分页：从上一条继续
title_en: Keyset pagination continues after the last key
prompt_zh: 制作 18 秒 1080p 60fps 双语分页对比，白底配墨绿游标与珊瑚 offset。记录按唯一递增 ID 排序，初始为 10、20、30、40、50、60，页长 3，均为演示数据。0–4 秒取得第一页 [10,20,30]；4–8 秒在前面插入 ID15；8–12 秒 offset=3 得到 [30,40,50] 并突出重复 30；12–15 秒使用 id>30 得到 [40,50,60]；15–18 秒说明稳定排序键和并发语义仍要定义。Canvas 将两条固定查询结果并列，render(t) 不从视觉位置推算 ID。声音对重复行使用中性重复点击，正确继续使用三音上行。验收两种结果准确，不承诺 keyset 对所有排序与更新都免问题。交付关键帧、代码、查询表、MP4。
prompt_en: Make an 18-second bilingual pagination comparison at 1080p and 60fps using white, dark green for cursors and coral for offsets. Sort records by unique ascending IDs: initially 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60, with page size three. These are demonstration rows. During 0–4s fetch [10,20,30]; 4–8s insert ID15 before the page boundary; 8–12s fetch with offset=3 and show [30,40,50], highlighting duplicated 30; 12–15s fetch with id>30 and show [40,50,60]; 15–18s state that stable sort keys and concurrency semantics still need definition. Compare two fixed query results in Canvas and derive render(t) from data, never visual positions. A neutral repeated click marks duplication; three ascending notes mark continuation. Verify both results and avoid claiming keyset solves every ordering or update issue. Deliver keyframes, source, query data and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: A repeated dry click identifies duplicated ID30; three short ascending tones accompany the keyset continuation without an error alarm.
recipe.audio_zh: 重复 ID30 使用两次干点击提示；游标继续使用三个短上行音，不采用警报声。
recipe.audio_en: A repeated dry click identifies duplicated ID30; three short ascending tones accompany the keyset continuation without an error alarm.
checks_zh: 插入 15 后 offset 页为 [30,40,50]，keyset 页为 [40,50,60]。
每行保留唯一 ID，终帧注明稳定排序与并发语义条件。
checks_en: After inserting 15, offset returns [30,40,50] and keyset returns [40,50,60].
Every row retains its unique ID; the final frame states ordering and concurrency conditions.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 剖面里的一条连续流路
title_en: One continuous route inside a section
prompt_zh: 用Three.js制作24秒内部通道示意，1080p、60fps。主体为原创矩形块内的蛇形通道，雾白背景、灰色壳体、青蓝流路和玫红入口。0–5秒展示封闭块体；5–11秒上半壳沿法线打开，露出通道；11–19秒一段有限长度的亮色线按路径从入口移至出口；19–24秒移除亮线、复合壳体并保持入口出口可见。只是路径动画，不是流体仿真，不宣称流速、压降或散热效率。通道中心线与宽度固定，render(t)计算线段范围，摄影机不穿壳体。声音为低声连续扫音与两次端点提示。检查通道连通、线段不越壁、壳体复合无穿插，交付双语关键帧、源码、路径参数和MP4。
prompt_en: Create a 24-second internal-channel schematic in Three.js at 1080p, 60fps. Build an original rectangular block containing a serpentine channel, with mist-white surroundings, a gray shell, cyan route and rose inlet. At 0–5s present the closed block; 5–11s lift the upper shell along its normal to reveal the channel; 11–19s move a finite highlighted segment from inlet to outlet along the path; 19–24s remove the highlight, reassemble the shell and keep both ports visible. This is a route animation, not fluid simulation; make no claims about velocity, pressure drop or cooling efficiency. Fix the channel centerline and width, deriving highlighted ranges from render(t) while keeping the camera outside the shell. Use a quiet continuous sweep and two endpoint cues. Verify channel connectivity, highlights confined within walls and intersection-free reassembly. Deliver bilingual keyframes, source, path parameters and MP4.

recipe.render: render(t) with fixed inputs and a fixed seed
recipe.audio: A quiet filtered sweep follows the highlighted route; two brief endpoint tones mark inlet and outlet.
checks_zh: 通道中心线连续且亮色线段全程位于通道壁内
上下壳体复合时没有几何穿插或端口遮挡
全部标签位于画面5%安全边界内且环绕镜头时主体不出画
checks_en: The channel centerline is continuous and highlights remain inside its walls
Shell reassembly creates no intersections or occluded ports
All labels remain within a five-percent frame-safe margin and the subject stays in frame during camera movement
recipe.audio_zh: 低声滤波扫音跟随高亮流路；入口与出口分别一声短音。
recipe.audio_en: A quiet filtered sweep follows the highlighted route; two brief endpoint tones mark inlet and outlet.

author: Prompt Motion Lab
title_zh: 记忆配对：翻开后记住位置
title_en: A memory-matching board with fixed positions

Only selected cards may reveal faces, matched cards stay face-up, and a third card cannot open during mismatch delay. Reconstruct render(t) from an immutable action table and seed rather than live click timing. Use soft paper flips and a short paired match cue. Verify two copies per symbol, action-derived counts and no stale timers after reset. Deliver keyframes, source, playable page, MP4 and shuffle order.

title_zh: 四拍节奏编辑器
title_en: A four-beat sequencer
prompt_zh: 做一个 4×8 的节奏编辑器。点击格子切换开关，空格键开始和暂停，播放头按 100 BPM 移动。每个格子的声音使用短促合成音，音频时间和播放头共享同一时钟。显示当前拍号和活动格子数量，切换语言不重置节奏。支持键盘聚焦、可见焦点和移动端触摸，检查快速连续点击时没有重复事件。自动演示 12 秒：0–3 秒布置四拍、3–9 秒播放两轮、9–12 秒暂停并标注结果；由固定种子和 render(t) 重现，交付关键帧、可交互 HTML、无声预览和带合成声音的 MP4。
prompt_en: Build a 4×8 beat sequencer. Clicking a cell toggles it; Space starts and pauses; a playhead advances at 100 BPM. Each cell uses a short synthesized sound, sharing one clock with the playhead. Show beat number and active-cell count; language switching must not reset the pattern. Support keyboard focus, visible focus and touch, and verify rapid clicks do not create duplicate events. The 12-second demo sets four beats from 0–3s, plays two rounds from 3–9s, then pauses and labels the result from 9–12s. Reproduce it from a fixed seed and render(t); deliver keyframes, interactive HTML, a silent preview and an MP4 with synthesized sound.

Give every marker a keyboard entry, show the zoom value as it changes and make Reset restore the fixed initial state. title_zh: 队列调试器

Use color plus labels for waiting, processing and done states. The 14-second demo enqueues three items at 0–3s, dequeues automatically at 3–7s, pauses and adds two at 7–10s, then resumes and resets at 10–14s. prompt_zh: 做一个可拖动排序的 6 项列表。拖动时显示插入位置、被推动的卡片和当前顺序；释放后用 180ms 的克制缓动落位。键盘用户可以用上下键移动项目，Space 抓取和放下。焦点、拖动和错误释放都要有文字反馈。不要用拖拽阴影遮住文字，移动端提供长按替代方案。自动演示镜头 0–3 秒建立列表，3–7 秒把第 2 项拖到第 5 项，7–9 秒键盘移动一项，9–12 秒展示错误释放并恢复；输入路径写在固定事件表中，由 render(t) 重现，使用合成抓取和落位音，交付关键帧、HTML 和 12 秒 MP4。
